FaqDATA.ques: What are the different learning alternatives available for Data Analytics Course?
FaqDATA.ans: We offer both offline and online learning options, plus a blended curriculum designed for working professionals who need more flexibility. Live online sessions let you interact with your instructor in real time, just as you would in a face-to-face class, and hands-on project work is done through cloud-based tools alongside the industrial project site work.

FaqDATA.ques: If I have to miss a lesson due to an emergency, would there be a make-up class available?
FaqDATA.ans: Every live session is recorded and you get unrestricted access to those recordings, so you can catch up whenever you need to. That said, we'd still recommend attending the live sessions where possible, since real-time interaction with the instructor is hard to fully replace.
